purpose: Diagnostic 10k MIRACL Arabic retrieval sample after stopping the uneconomic full Qwen3-Embedding-8B MIRACLRetrieval run.

sample.note: The sample includes all positive documents for the selected queries and fills the remaining corpus with random negatives, so scores are intentionally easier than full MIRACLRetrieval.

interpretation: The full Qwen3-Embedding-8B MIRACLRetrieval ar run should remain stopped on the current L20 workflow because the full dense MTEB path is too slow for routine iteration.
The 10k positive-plus-negatives sample confirms the model and evaluation path work and that Qwen3-Embedding-8B ranks the constructed positives strongly.
The sample score is inflated by design and must not be used as a SOTA, leaderboard, or full MIRACL claim.
Use Qwen3-Embedding-8B as a high-end diagnostic or teacher on smaller batches unless the full retrieval workflow is optimized with caching, FAISS, or a more efficient evaluator.
